title: 央行郭凯：人民币被低估20%？大幅升值反伤出口
speaker: Guo Kai

segments.en: And for next year, I think A, it depends on what growth target would they want to target.
segments.zh: 对于明年，我认为首先取决于他们想要设定什么样的增长目标。

segments.en: My sense is that they probably won't want to target the similar level of growth this year.
segments.zh: 我的感觉是，他们可能不想设定与今年相似的增长水平。

segments.en: If that's the case, I think next year they will need a considerable physical package to allow that will happen.
segments.zh: 如果是那样，我认为明年他们将需要相当大的财政方案来实现这一点。

segments.en: What do you think the thinking is right now on the value of the REM and B? There's been more calls, even the IMF says it's undervalued, until we can get some significant structural changes, and also some stimulus is needed in this economy.
segments.zh: 你认为目前对人民币汇率的看法是什么？有更多呼声，甚至IMF也说它被低估了，直到我们能进行一些重大结构性改革，经济也需要一些刺激。

segments.en: Goldman Sachs says REM and B in real terms could be undervalued by 20 to 25%, it could go next year, there's a feasibility whether there's a will that the PBOC is another question, for the REM and B to go down to about 6 to the US dollar.
segments.zh: 高盛表示，人民币实际汇率可能被低估20%至25%，明年可能达到，是否可行以及央行是否有意愿是另一个问题，人民币兑美元可能降至约6。

segments.en: Do you see the need for that, even though it's already appreciated about 4% this year against the dollar?
segments.zh: 你认为有必要吗，尽管今年人民币兑美元已经升值约4%？

segments.en: You know, REM and B is definitely very cheap right now. But I think appreciating like 20% or 15% over a year would be counterpart productive.
segments.zh: 你知道，人民币现在肯定非常便宜。但我认为一年内升值20%或15%会适得其反。

segments.en: Those for China and for the world, I think for China it would hurt export a lot and the slow Chinese growth. And for the world it's going to be a cost shark or a price shark to global importers.
segments.zh: 对中国和世界来说，我认为对中国会严重损害出口并拖慢增长。对世界而言，将对全球进口商造成成本冲击或价格冲击。
